# data-safety-from-code

> An open-source agent skill (SKILL.md format) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot that scans an Android codebase and generates the Google Play Data safety form as a CSV that Play Console can import, with file:line or vendor-source evidence for every answer. The output is a draft for the developer to review. MIT license.

Key facts:
- Play Console: App content → Data safety → Export to CSV / Import to CSV. Importing replaces the whole form.
- The CSV has one row per possible answer (782 in the current template) and 5 columns: Question ID, Response ID, Response value (true/false/blank/text), Answer requirement, label. Only the Response value column is filled; rows are never added or reordered.
- Collected = sent off the device. Shared = sent to a third party; a service provider acting for the developer is not sharing. IP-derived location must be declared as Approximate location.
- The scan reads AndroidManifest.xml, build.gradle(.kts), libs.versions.toml, ./gradlew dependencies output, network_security_config.xml and Kotlin/Java source. Python 3.9+, standard library only.
- 21 SDK entries (12 from official vendor disclosures): Firebase, AdMob, UMP, RevenueCat, Play Billing, Sign in with Google, ML Kit, OneSignal, Facebook, Sentry, Mixpanel, OpenAI and Gemini clients.

Install:
- Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add sanikantv/data-safety-from-code then /plugin install data-safety-from-code@data-safety-from-code
- Other agents: npx --yes skills add sanikantv/data-safety-from-code --skill data-safety-from-code -y
